title: Access request
description: Schema contract for access-request events produced by a ForgeKey badge_reader (credential reader) and consumed by OMS. The device is a pure sensor: it reads a credential and publishes this event on forgekey/<mac>/access/request. It makes NO access decision and holds NO allowlist; OMS resolves the credential, authorizes, and drives the relay/lock/indicator over the existing command channel.

schema_version.description: Immutable contract identifier for this payload shape.

credential_type.description: Kind of credential presented. v1 firmware emits only 'badge'; 'otp' is reserved for a deferred follow-up.

credential_id.description: The credential value. For 'badge' this is the card UID as uppercase hex with no separators (e.g. '04A1B2C3D4'). For 'otp' it is the entered code string.

reader_id.description: Identifier of the reader/channel that produced the read, for devices with more than one reader. Defaults to 'main'.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds when the credential was read. Present only when the device clock is valid; absent otherwise.

x-compatibility-notes: OMS consumers must accept unknown additional properties for additive firmware releases.
OMS consumers should route by schema_version before applying payload-specific validation.
credential_id for badges is uppercase hex of the raw UID; OMS matching should be case-insensitive to tolerate firmware variation.
timestamp is epoch seconds and is only present when the device clock is valid; fall back to ingest time for ordering when it is absent.
The device is server-authoritative: it never decides access. OMS authorizes and responds via existing forgekey/<mac>/command verbs (enable/disable/unlock/set_indicator).
